'''Warrior monks''' were members of the [[Sedrian]] society on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. They were tasked with the defense of Sedrian [[City/Legends|cities]] and villages, and were led by the [[bishop of war]]. The warrior monks were called upon to enforce the will of the [[High Priest of the Golden Sun]], using [[spear gun]]s and [[sun gun]]s.<ref name="BGS" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], when a team of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] were on-world while searching for the stolen [[Barani List]] on behalf of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Sprax]], they were assigned an escort of five of these [[Warrior-monk/Legends|warrior monks]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Mors Odrion]]. The group made their way to a [[Sedrian village]] that had recently been massacred by a rival team of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]&mdash;working for Black Sun's [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]&mdash;and were [[Skirmish in the underwater caves|attacked]] by four surviving villagers. When Xizor's team revealed themselves and joined in the fray, the villagers recognized the warrior monks and quickly aligned themselves with Sprax's team.
